Finally finished making my QWISO Shatter tutorial.

[The word QWISO brings up images in your head like this.](https://i.sli.mg/ifl5cy.jpg) Contrary to popular belief: the QWISO method can be used to make some very great, very clean shatter. Very few additional materials are needed. Basically just a freezer and the highest concentration of isopropyl alcohol you can get your hands on.

Our goal here is to minimize the amount of plant wax, chlorophyll, etc that end up in our final product, while maximizing the amount of psychoactive resins we extract.

**SUPER IMPORTANT**

DO NOT DO THIS IN A HOUSE WITH POOR VENTILATION AND/OR PILATE LIGHTS

THAT'S WHAT BACKYARDS / SHEDS ARE FOR

------------------------

[Step 1: Get your herbs](https://i.sli.mg/mypEEy.jpg)

Dry your herb as much as possible. It cannot be too dry for this process.

[Step 2: Bake your herbs](https://i.sli.mg/FyUK32.jpg)

Bake your herbs at 200F until they crumble (Think super dry autumn leaves)

[**Step 3**: Freeze your herbs and your alcohol](https://i.sli.mg/5Xc0DA.jpg)

Take it out of the oven, seal in airtight jar while it's still warm, and place it in your freezer along with your iso.

Keep in the freezer until they're as cold as they can get.

**Step 4: Fun**

Cover your herb with the cold iso, shake vigorously for a maximum of 20 seconds. (I went a little over 20 trying to take pictures)

The person who taught me this used a chinois, but I use a coffee filter and I get similar results.

From here we do the standard dry: Pour the filtered product onto a wide plate / dish. Place a fan so that it blows across the surface. Having a dust free environment is vital.
